title: VibeVoiceParams
description: Long-form VibeVoice reference prompt. file_stem matches <file_prefix>-<Name>_<gender>[_bgm].wav. file_prefix is the filename token (en, zh, in). The voice language is the BCP-47 tag for that prefix. _bgm is a real suffix (en-Mary_woman_bgm, zh-Anchen_man_bgm). Model identity, cfg_scale, diffusion steps, speaker limit, and output rate live on the registry models, because one reference WAV works with both 1.5B and 7B.
